title: GoHighLevel Project Manager
systemName: One client project, from handover to delivery

facts: UK GoHighLevel consultancy wants a technical project manager or small delivery team to own client projects from handover to completion.

Responsibilities: end-to-end GHL implementations, coordinating developers, designers and automation specialists, CRM, workflows, funnels, integrations, client Zoom and email, timelines, testing, revisions, quality control.
Asks for GHL project examples, independent vs team, client management experience, a short Loom intro and typical pricing (pricing left out).
No client or contact name in the post or reviews; personalization omitted.
